title: DIABETIC MACULAR EDEMA AND CATARACT SURGERY
condition: Nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy with macular edema and visually significant cataract (laser-treated PDR also admitted), HbA1c at most 9%, no corticosteroid for DME in the previous 6 months; 46 patients, Policlinico Bari, 2018-2019; retrospective comparative cohort, phacoemulsification with dexamethasone implant matched with consecutive phacoemulsification alone; some eyes were on ranibizumab treatment at baseline (9 and 11)

groups.agent: dexamethasone intravitreal implant (Ozurdex) injected via pars plana at the end of phacoemulsification with IOL implantation
phacoemulsification with IOL implantation, no intravitreal treatment at surgery
groups.description: Group 2: standard phacoemulsification alone; eyes given rescue dexamethasone implant during follow-up were removed from the later analyses (Results)

series.baseline_label: Baseline, Phaco-Dex (Table 3, row 3, column 1; values sit in the third header row)
series.notes: Mean +/- SD (Table 3 footnote); monthly visits after surgery; no drop-outs in this group during the 3-month follow-up

series.baseline_label: Baseline, Phaco-alone (Table 3, row 3, column 5; values sit in the third header row)
series.notes: Mean +/- SD; the month-1 value still has the full group (the footnotes give reduced n only at months 2 and 3); eyes that received rescue dexamethasone implant from month 1 onward were removed from later visits, so months 2 and 3 are excluded

exclusions.reason: Values after the first rescue event: eyes given rescue dexamethasone implant were removed from the analysis (footnotes give reduced n at 2 and 3 months); only visits before the first rescue with the full baseline number of eyes are kept

exclusions.what: Table 3 rows 4-5 (mean difference between groups and its 95% CI)
exclusions.reason: Between-group differences and CI bounds are not extracted
Duplicate (rounded) of the Table 3 baselines for the same eyes; Table 3 cited

notes: Measure: CST defined in Methods as the average thickness in the central 1-mm ETDRS grid (Cirrus SD-OCT): central_subfield, device cirrus.
Time origin: the day of surgery (all eyes underwent phacoemulsification at time 0; the dexamethasone implant was given at the end of surgery in Group 1).

Treatment: the Phaco-Dex arm is recorded as steroid_implant with phacoemulsification as a co-intervention; the Phaco-alone arm declares treatment other (cataract surgery without intravitreal treatment), because some of its eyes were on ranibizumab treatment at baseline and the arm is not untreated.
Prior treatment mixed: some eyes on ranibizumab at baseline and laser-treated PDR admitted.
Group n is reported per group (23 each); the article reports patients, one eye per patient is implied but not stated.
Between-group comparisons used multilevel regression models; the tabulated values are observed means.
